summary: GPO Plus filed an 8-K disclosing a September 7, 2026 Asset Purchase Agreement under which its new ClearLine Apps subsidiary will acquire SurgePays' ClearLine engagement platform, media network and GPOX Wireless assets for $27,500,000. Consideration is 25,000,000 shares of GPO Plus Series D Preferred, convertible one-for-one into common, non-voting with no dividend or liquidation preference. SurgePays holds a three-year-plus-90-day put to sell those shares to Emerald Shoals for $27.5M; GPO Plus issues Emerald Shoals a five-year warrant for 15M shares at $0.05/$0.15/$0.25 tranches. Watch dilution, conversion overhang and closing conditions.
